metrics.name: roboinvest_unexpected_error_count
metrics.description: Structured roboinvest application logs at ERROR severity or higher.

metrics.name: roboinvest_closeout_invariant_count
metrics.description: OMS Live closeout invariant violations requiring operator review.

metrics.name: roboinvest_market_data_stale_count
metrics.description: Feature Engine or OMS market-data stale warnings during the JPX session.

metrics.name: roboinvest_broker_order_rejected_count
metrics.description: Broker order rejections emitted by OMS Live.

metrics.name: roboinvest_market_data_summary_count

metrics.name: roboinvest_order_published_count

metrics.name: roboinvest_order_filled_count

metrics.name: roboinvest_closeout_completed_count
metrics.description: Closeout orders completed by OMS Live.

metrics.name: roboinvest_feature_received_per_window
metrics.description: Raw market-data messages received by Feature Engine in each summary window.
metrics.filter: logName="projects/${PROJECT_ID}/logs/roboinvest" AND jsonPayload.service="feature-engine" AND jsonPayload.event="market_data_summary" AND jsonPayload.received:*
